page_title: WER 2-2 LEV | Werder Bremen v Bayer Leverkusen 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' Lukas Hradecky pulls off a great save to deny Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
90+5' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 2 Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top left corner in trademark fashion.
88' Florian Badstubner has issued a yellow card to Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
86' Substitution. Julian Malatini makes way for Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
85' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the right post!
84' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
83' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
83' The game has come to an end for Amos Pieper. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen).
82' Here comes a substitution. Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Felix Agu.
82' A substitution has been made. Martin Terrier is replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Here is a change. Marco Grull is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen).
81' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.
81' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
77' 1 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Felix Agu (Werder Bremen), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:2.
75' 1 - 1 Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
72' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
72' The attendance is 42100.

71' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Victor Boniface and he is replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
69' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
68' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt walks off the pitch and Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
65' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement.

63' The ball is laid off to Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Michael Zetterer to make a decent save.
59' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

57' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
55' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Michael Zetterer has no trouble gathering it.

55' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Michael Zetterer, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
51' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
50' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
49' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
46' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes a direct free kick.
45+3' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

44' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
40' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

38' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.

37' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
36' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
34' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.

30' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Jeremie Frimpong, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Michael Zetterer with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 0:1.
29' The resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) comes to nothing.
28' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
27' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
20' The linesman raises his flag. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
19' The resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared.

19' What a sweet touch by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny him! It will be a corner kick for Werder Bremen.

18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Werder Bremen.
15' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
14' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Lukas Hradecky.
13' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.

9' That's a well-taken pass by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
8' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
8' The game is interrupted now, Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Flag goes up against Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
4' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is the one to supervise the game today.
